mvp_session.name: Tamil starter anchor, transfer, and review test
mvp_session.goal: Test whether five short Tamil chunks transfer from anchor scenes into new visual contexts and delayed review scenes.

practice_cards.prompt: Watch and listen to the Tamil greeting exchange.
practice_cards.success_signal: learner completes first exposure

practice_cards.prompt: A classmate asks your name. Listen, then say the learner line in Tamil.
practice_cards.success_signal: learner completes first exposure

practice_cards.prompt: The staff member speaks too fast. Listen, then ask them to say it slowly in Tamil.
practice_cards.success_signal: learner completes first exposure

practice_cards.prompt: The friend greets you. Say the learner line in Tamil.
practice_cards.success_signal: learner produces a greeting and wellbeing question

practice_cards.prompt: The staff member is speaking too fast. Choose what the learner should say.

choices.why: The problem is speed, so the learner asks for slower speech.
This is a shop request, not a repair phrase.
There is no buying or price question in this moment.

practice_cards.success_signal: learner distinguishes speech-speed repair from unrelated requests

practice_cards.prompt: The staff member is using too much language. Tell them you know only a little Tamil.
practice_cards.success_signal: learner can use a safety phrase instead of freezing

practice_cards.prompt: The shopkeeper is offering the item. What social job does the learner need?
practice_cards.success_signal: learner reads politeness as the intention, not just the object

practice_cards.prompt: You want the bottle of water. Say the learner line in Tamil.
practice_cards.success_signal: learner requests a visible object politely

practice_cards.prompt: You are lost and need the bus stop. Ask where it is in Tamil.
practice_cards.success_signal: learner produces a direction question from visual need

practice_cards.prompt: The learner is coughing at the pharmacy. Choose the useful Tamil response.

choices.why: The visible need is cough medicine.
This is useful if the pharmacist spoke too fast, but the visual need is medicine.
Price can come later; first the learner needs to ask for medicine.

practice_cards.success_signal: learner maps symptom and setting to the medicine request

practice_cards.prompt: You are at the pharmacy and need medicine for a cough.
practice_cards.success_signal: learner produces the pharmacy request from visual intention

practice_cards.prompt: Roleplay a tiny Tamil shop exchange using only known functions.
practice_cards.roleplay_goal: Buy a bottle of water and close politely.
practice_cards.success_signal: learner completes a short exchange without translation

practice_cards.prompt: Use the new scene. Say your part when prompted, then hear the model line.
practice_cards.success_signal: learner reuses ta-target-hello-how-are-you in a same day transfer scene

practice_cards.prompt: Use the new scene. Say your part when prompted, then hear the model line.
practice_cards.success_signal: learner reuses ta-target-my-name-is in a same day transfer scene

practice_cards.prompt: Use the new scene. Say your part when prompted, then hear the model line.
practice_cards.success_signal: learner reuses ta-target-say-it-slowly in a same day transfer scene

practice_cards.prompt: Watch the scene once. Then replay the cue and say your part when prompted.

ai_scene_contract.physical_scene: A friendly person sees the learner at a casual community event.

target_function.definition: The learner responds appropriately when someone says hi or hello.

ai_scene_contract.learner_intention: Respond to a friendly greeting in Tamil.
acceptance_notes: Accept romanized attempts such as konnichiwa when the transcription clearly captured the greeting.
For this first beginner scene, do not require an added wellbeing question.

wrong_intents.definition: The learner says nothing or gives no greeting-like response.
The learner asks something unrelated to greeting the person.
The learner immediately says goodbye or leaves.

practice_cards.success_signal: learner hears the full scene, then successfully supplies the missing greeting response

practice_cards.prompt: Watch the scene once. Then replay the cue and say your part when prompted.

ai_scene_contract.physical_scene: A classmate meets the learner in a school hallway and asks their name.
ai_scene_contract.learner_role: new student being asked their name

target_function.definition: The learner says their own name in a simple introduction.

ai_scene_contract.learner_intention: Tell the classmate that your name is Anna in Tamil.
example_valid_responses: 私の名前はアンナです
acceptance_notes: Accept Ana/Anna spelling variation if the utterance clearly introduces the learner.

wrong_intents.definition: The learner only says hi without giving a name.
The learner asks for the other person's name instead of giving their own.
The learner only thanks the partner.

practice_cards.success_signal: learner introduces themself after being asked their name

practice_cards.prompt: Watch the scene once. Then replay the cue and say your part when prompted.

ai_scene_contract.physical_scene: A staff member gives the learner a form and instructions at a busy service counter.
ai_scene_contract.learner_role: person who does not understand the instruction

target_function.definition: The learner politely signals that they do not understand what was said.

ai_scene_contract.learner_intention: Say that you do not understand in Tamil.
example_valid_responses: すみません、わかりません
すみません、分かりません
acceptance_notes: Accept romanized attempts such as sumimasen wakarimasen when the transcription clearly captures the phrase.

wrong_intents.definition: The learner asks the partner to speak slowly instead of saying they do not understand.
The learner says yes or agrees even though the scene calls for repair.
The learner requests an unrelated object or service.

practice_cards.success_signal: learner uses a repair phrase instead of freezing

practice_cards.prompt: Watch the scene once. Then replay the cue and say your part when prompted.

ai_scene_contract.physical_scene: At a busy counter, the staff calls the next person forward while still looking down, and the learner politely gets the staff member's attention.
ai_scene_contract.learner_role: person politely getting the staff member's attention

target_function.definition: The learner politely gets attention from someone who is busy or not looking.

ai_scene_contract.learner_intention: Say excuse me in Tamil so the staff member looks up and gives attention.
acceptance_notes: Accept romanized attempts such as sumimasen when clear.

wrong_intents.definition: The learner thanks the partner instead of getting attention.
The learner only greets the partner.
The learner orders food or asks for an item.

practice_cards.success_signal: learner uses a short polite apology

practice_cards.prompt: Watch the scene once. Then replay the cue and say your part when prompted.
practice_cards.expected_response: サンドイッチください。

ai_scene_contract.physical_scene: A server at a casual food counter asks what the learner wants to order.

target_function.definition: The learner orders one visible food item politely.

ai_scene_contract.learner_intention: Ask for a sandwich politely in Tamil.
example_valid_responses: サンドイッチください
サンドイッチをください
サンドイッチお願いします
acceptance_notes: Accept an order for a sandwich even if the particle is omitted.
Accept romanized attempts such as sandoicchi kudasai when clear.

wrong_intents.definition: The learner asks how much it costs instead of ordering.
The learner asks where something is.
The learner says they do not understand instead of ordering.

practice_cards.success_signal: learner orders a simple food item politely

practice_cards.prompt: Use the new scene. Say your part when prompted, then hear the model line.
